text:
ada: quick flag 10: our cost dashboard is showing huge cache savings attributed to model 'tiny-v1' but our per-route query breaks it across many routes. spotted during quota review.

leo: can you paste the quick query and a sample event? sounds like either billing_context canonicalization or a sampling/upscaling bug.

ada: quick query i ran:
```
SELECT tenant_id, route_id, model_sku, SUM(tokens) tokens, SUM(cache_saved_tokens) saved
FROM token_events
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '6 hours'
GROUP BY tenant_id, route_id, model_sku
ORDER BY saved DESC
LIMIT 25;
```
rows show 3 routes contributing but dashboard sums to a single model row.

frank: we recently changed the normalizer to collapse low-cardinality keys into `billing_key` to reduce ingest. apparently route_id was folded into metadata blob for some events and aggregator only groups by billing_key.

ada: product ask: can we provide a toggle in the card to switch Attribution Mode: conservative (model-first) vs granular (route-first)? conservative keeps legacy numbers; granular shows per-route breakdown when available.

leo: backend plan: emit explicit columns (route_id, model_sku, sample_weight) to token_ledger. introduce `attribution_mode` flag and a server-side top-N route bucketing (N=5). aggregator will compute two columns: observed_saved and attributed_saved. will also emit delta metric per-tenant.

frank: sampling complicates this. for sampled telemetry we should emit sample_weight=1/sampling_rate and aggregator should use weighted sums. cap weight to 100x to avoid single-event blowups. also add `attribution_reason` enum (ROUTE_PRESENT, SAMPLED_ESTIMATE, FALLBACK_MODEL) so UI can explain why attribution happened.

ui-review-bot: ui note: we'll add small pill showing Attribution Mode and a Confidence badge (High/Medium/Low) derived from sampling + route-cardinality. show top-5 routes + "other" row. tooltip copy: "Attribution Mode: explains how cache savings are allocated. Confidence: shows how reliable the attribution is."

deploy-bot: Canary deploy for ingest-normalizer started by @deploybot at 2026-08-17T19:02:10Z :rocket:

leo: rollout plan: land normalizer change + schema migration to add explicit columns. backfill attributed_route for last 7 days into new ledger table asynchronously. gate UI behind feature flag `console.costs.granular_attrib` default off. enable in staging, run 24h canary, then 10% prod.

ada: tests: unit for two events same model_sku different routes ensure attributed_saved splits per-route; integration for sampling upscaling accuracy within 5% of live non-sampled baseline; UI e2e for toggle and confidence display.

frank: operational guardrails: add automatic drift alert that triggers if attributed_saved delta >20% for any tenant in 1h window post-rollout; flag auto-rolls back for that tenant. also emit histogram of per-tenant cardinality to monitor explosion.

ada: small UX ask: when mode is switched to granular, show a changelog blurb and a one-time banner: "Numbers may shift; toggle to compare legacy view".

leo: i'll open a draft PR with normalizer + migration + small backfill job. linking here when ready.

ada: thanks. ping me when staging flag is on so we can run the quota/cost checks for a few tenants. :+1:
